1. Timestamps of failed attempts

args.body:
Hi Riley,

I'm following up on the webhook retry incident that was reported. To help us investigate and resolve this issue more effectively, we need some additional diagnostic information that appears to be missing from the initial report.

Could you please provide the following details:

1. Timestamps of the failed webhook attempts
2. Error codes or response messages received
3. The payload data that was being sent
4. Any relevant logs from your webhook endpoint
5. Configuration details of your webhook setup

This information will help us identify the root cause and implement the appropriate fix.

Please let me know if you need any assistance gathering these details.

Best regards
args.subject: Follow-up: Webhook Retry Incident - Request for Missing Diagnostics

args.comment: Followed up with the customer (Riley Stone) via email to request missing diagnostic information for the webhook retry incident. Requested timestamps, error codes, payload data, logs, and configuration details to help investigate the root cause.
